title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. Very cheaply made or more like a art and craft day in 1st grade, like things were added to it to make it look cheesy , the attachment are made of small " key ring " and the border are wrap with cheap wire! Oh and it is not crystal...!

product_metadata.title: French Taper 19 1/2" High Droplets Candelabra
features: Bright gold finish over poly resin.
Clear and amber colored droplet accents.
description: Crystal-like droplets and beads adorn this luxurious candelabra. Display four taper candles (not included) in style with this bright gold finished accessory. The amber and clear accents are stunning when fused with the carved details and leaf-like bobeche.
